name: Chicago house
blurb: Shuffling drum machines, an organ bass and piano chords.

sounds.why: A firm kick on every beat. House was named for it: four on the floor, all night.

sounds.name: Shuffled hats and clap
sounds.why: Sixteenth-note hats with every second one late and quiet. That lilt is the difference between house and a metronome.

ingredients.name: Sixteenth hats
ingredients.adds: Sixteen identical hats to the bar, from the default kit.

ingredients.name: The 707
ingredients.adds: The TR-707's bright, tight sampled hat.

ingredients.name: Loud, quiet, loud, quiet
ingredients.adds: Hats on the beat and offbeat are louder than the ones between.

knobs.label: clap level
knobs.above: It is louder than the kick.

ingredients.name: Open hat
ingredients.adds: An open hat on every offbeat.

knobs.below: Straight and stiff: techno, not house.

sounds.name: Parallel chord stab
sounds.why: One minor seventh chord, sampled, then played from different keys. Every note moves by the same amount, which no pianist would do and every sampler does.
Soft strings held over the drums. They turn a drum track into a song.
